nodes.description: ZethrInterface instance stored at fixed address 0xD48B633045af65fF636F3c6edd744748351E020D; target of external buyAndTransfer and balanceOf calls.
Address storing the bankroll destination, initialized to 0x7430984e1D05d5F447c747123dd26845f6f17544 and mutable by owner.
Owner address set to msg.sender at deployment; used for access control in changeBankroll and sendDivsToBankroll.
Payable external function that measures token balance delta around zethr.buyAndTransfer and emits onTokenPurchase.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether with no logic; entry point for forced/plain transfers.
Owner-only function that reassigns the bankroll state variable.
Owner-only function that transfers the whole contract balance to the bankroll address.
External payable interface function of ZethrInterface invoked with value(msg.value) to buy tokens.
External view interface function returning the token balance of an address.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, access-control checks, balance lookups and as referral/target argument.
External payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value)(_referredBy, msg.sender, "", divChoice) executed before state/balance finalization.
Ether transfer bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) sending the full contract balance to a mutable address.
Unchecked subtraction balanceAfter - balanceBefore (Solidity 0.4.24) used as the minted-token amount in the event.
Caller-supplied referral address of buyTokensWithProperEvent, forwarded to the external purchase call and event.
Caller-supplied uint8 dividend-rate selector forwarded verbatim to the external buy call.
Caller-supplied address used to overwrite the bankroll state variable in changeBankroll.
Address argument of the external balanceOf interface call.
Local variable capturing zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) prior to the external purchase.
Local variable capturing zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) after the external purchase.

edges.reason: owner state variable is initialized directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender at deployment.
msg.sender is used in buyTokensWithProperEvent as the balance-query subject and event customerAddress.
msg.sender flows as the target argument into the external payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value).
Caller-supplied _referredBy is forwarded into the external buyAndTransfer call.
Caller-supplied divChoice is forwarded into the external buyAndTransfer call.
buyTokensWithProperEvent executes the external call to zethr before the balance is read after the call and before the event is emitted.
The zethr state variable is the callee contract of the value-transferring external call.
buyTokensWithProperEvent invokes zethr.balanceOf both before and after the purchase.
msg.sender is passed as the _owner argument to the external balanceOf calls.
balanceBefore local is assigned from the pre-purchase balanceOf call inside buyTokensWithProperEvent.
balanceAfter local is assigned from the post-purchase balanceOf call inside buyTokensWithProperEvent.
balanceBefore is an operand of the unchecked subtraction producing the minted amount.
balanceAfter is an operand of the unchecked subtraction producing the minted amount.
The subtraction result is emitted by buyTokensWithProperEvent as tokensMinted.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the require of changeBankroll.
owner state variable is the access-control reference used by changeBankroll.
The _newBankroll parameter overwrites the bankroll state variable.
changeBankroll performs the state write to bankroll after the owner check.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the require of sendDivsToBankroll.
owner state variable is the access-control reference used by sendDivsToBankroll.
sendDivsToBankroll triggers the external ether transfer to bankroll.
The mutable bankroll state variable is the recipient of the full-balance external transfer.
The external payable buyAndTransfer call can re-enter the contract through the payable fallback before the caller's post-call accounting completes.
The bankroll ether transfer may trigger execution in the recipient, potentially reaching the payable fallback.

normalization_plan.reason: _referredBy is only a pass-through parameter consumed by the external buyAndTransfer unsafe operation.
divChoice only parameterizes the external buyAndTransfer unsafe operation.
_newBankroll is used solely inside changeBankroll to update the bankroll state variable.
_owner only parameterizes the external balanceOf interface call.
balanceBefore is a temporary snapshot taken before the external buyAndTransfer call and merges into that unsafe operation.
balanceAfter is a temporary snapshot taken after the external buyAndTransfer call and merges into that unsafe operation.
